import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
flat_size = 10     # 对边距 (mm)
thickness = 4      # 厚度 (mm)
hole_d = 5         # 螺纹孔直径 (mm)
chamfer_size = 0.5 # 倒角 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, flat_size * 2 / math.sqrt(3))
    .extrude(thickness)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(hole_d)
    .faces(">Z").chamfer(chamfer_size)
    .faces("<Z").chamfer(chamfer_size)
)

show_object(result)
